title: Hold an employer's authority to employ children
what: Hold an employer's authority from the Children's Guardian before employing children in the activities the Act lists (such as entertainment, exhibitions and still photography).

sources.title: Children's Guardian Act 2019 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not employ a child to carry out the following activities unless the person holds an employer's authority that authorises the person to employ children to carry out the activity—

sources.title: Children's Guardian Act 2019 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Children's Guardian means the Children's Guardian appointed under section 115

reach.condition: if it employs children in the activities the Act lists (such as entertainment, exhibitions and still photography)
